LESSON: READING 5.2.1 VISUAL MEMORY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Visual memory
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.1 Visual memory, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: What things did you see on your way to school? 2. Which things are found at your home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Visual memory together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Social justice: unity as learners take turns while giving answers to questions and matching pictures.

● Integrity: Honesty as learner gives the correct information on things seen on the way to school with the teacher probes more

where the learner may seem not to be saying the truth.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental awareness as learner learns about things found in the neighbourhood and their uses.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Creative activities (music) as learners present signed songs during parade and get feedback on clarity.

Suggested Learning Resources:

assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, signed audio visual recordings, relevant

digital devices, online resources, storybooks, pictures, flashcards.
